text: マヒ　させられないよう　きを　つけな！

structure.jp: マヒ　させられないよう
structure.en: so that you don't get paralyzed

patterns.name: 〜ように
patterns.explanation: よう (short for ように) after a 'not' verb means 'so that it doesn't happen'. マヒ させられないよう = 'so that you don't get paralyzed'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: マヒ　させられない
patterns.explanation: マヒさせる is 'to paralyze someone'; adding られる turns it around to 'be paralyzed by someone'. マヒ させられない = 'not get paralyzed'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: な after the verb stem is a casual short form of なさい, a friendly order. きを つけな = 'be careful'.
